create_Qwen3Config: create a Qwen3Config instance to configure a Qwen3 model with default hyperparameters
initialize_Qwen3Config_custom: initialize a Qwen3Config with custom hyperparameters like hidden_size and num_hidden_layers
build_Qwen3_model_from_config: build a Qwen3Model from a Qwen3Config instance for model initialization
configure_sliding_window_attention: configure Qwen3Config with sliding window attention and max_window_layers settings
access_Qwen3Config_attributes: access Qwen3Config attributes like vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_attention_heads
